gen-dafont-vogue-fs-paquito: Hairline entry strokes dive into fat black stems, and that swing from thread to beam is what defines Vogue. Paquito then keeps its lowercase close to the capitals, so a brief run of text settles in without fuss.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-abeezee: Commanding and a bit vintage, Woodgod lets its tall lowercase nearly reach the capitals. ABeeZee sits beside it with round letters whose rims match the stems, giving the display face a friendly, level partner.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-alexandria: Vintage in spirit, Woodgod opens a wide channel into every bowl and stretches its lowercase toward the capitals. And Alexandria, tall-bodied with short stems, gives that display voice a clean, professional counterpart.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-amiko: Text here reads modern and neutral, with crayon-tall lowercase and terminals that point outward like tongs. Amiko is the sans-serif that does the quiet reading, while Woodgod, with its wide bowl channels, supplies the commanding vintage punch.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-kannada: Blunt vintage swagger, thanks to Woodgod and its wide-channeled bowls. Anek Kannada over many lines stays easy going, its high squared-off x-height, plus terminals stopping far from the stem, keeping each word open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase close to the capitals, with curve tips that never quite touch, giving a clean contemporary line. Woodgod earns its keep big and short, a commanding word or two.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-anek-tamil: Vintage muscle up front, courtesy of Woodgod and its tall lowercase. Anek Tamil then rolls along on big round lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped curves, easy on the eye over many lines.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Approachable is the first word for Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, whose lowercase eyes are big and whose rounds stay unlatched. Woodgod supplies the vintage swagger while the body stays open and friendly.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-gafata: A wide channel runs into every bowl of Woodgod, and its lowercase climbs nearly to the capitals with vintage confidence. Both stand tall, and Gafata gives that height a wide-eyed e.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-geist: Woodgod brings a commanding, vintage voice, with wide channels into every bowl and tall lowercase. But Geist stays quiet, every stroke the same gauge, and that restraint is the pair's best trick.
